description: This file sets up and exports configuration functions for Vitest extensions, including loading include patterns from environment variables and creating scoped Vitest configurations for extensions.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads a list of include patterns from environment variables or defaults to a function call.

methods.name: export function createExtensionProvidersVitestConfig( createExtensionProvidersVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vitest configuration object scoped for extension providers, with patterns loaded from environment or default roots.
